method.clock: exact original virtual-minute transitions; checkpoints sampled at corresponding real-day boundaries
method.fee: 5% on positive realized gains at independent hypothetical end-of-period liquidation, per stock; no loss offset
method.portfolio: 1000 bananas equally allocated by coin amount over 20 stocks at the starting quote; no rebalancing or deposits
method.noiseVariants: specified noise ratios combined with separately specified extra-growth components; these are combined settings, not an isolated noise test
method.coverage: minute-level stock extrema; portfolio drawdown sampled each virtual hour
method.selection: extra growth settings chosen after the pilot; five scenarios and two entirely new seeds fixed before this validation run; no tuning within validation
method.notTested: active trading strategies or production API behavior
